subject: maths
question: The area of the base of a right circular cone is 25π cm² and its height is 12 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm2) of the cone?
solution:
**Given:**

Area of the base of the cone = 25π cm²

Height of the cone = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cone = π × r × l

where r = radius of the base, l = slant height

Slant height, l = √(r² + h²)

**Calculation:**

Area of the base = π × r² = 25π

⇒ r² = 25

⇒ r = √25

⇒ r = 5 cm

Slant height, l = √(r² + h²)

⇒ l = √(5² + 12²)

⇒ l = √(25 + 144)

⇒ l = √169

⇒ l = 13 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = π × r × l

⇒ CSA = π × 5 × 13

⇒ CSA = 65π cm²

**The curved surface area of the cone is 65π cm².**
